subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should the PR's operation-gated delivery resolver and QQBot reconnect drain become the accepted compatibility boundary for outbound channel delivery?
rationale: The code path appears correct and well covered, but it changes central plugin resolution and queued-delivery replay behavior that can affect existing channels and upgrades beyond what CI alone proves.

options.title: Accept current shape after owner review
options.body: Approve the operation-aware delivery resolver plus QQBot reconnect drain if channel/gateway owners are comfortable with the compatibility and replay semantics.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller resolver or drain adjustment if maintainers want weaker replay bypass, different error semantics, or stricter plugin capability handling.

options.title: Pause for replacement
options.body: Close or pause this PR only if maintainers prefer a different architecture for reconnect recovery or outbound plugin activation.

recommendation.title: Accept current shape after owner review
recommendation.body: Approve the operation-aware delivery resolver plus QQBot reconnect drain if channel/gateway owners are comfortable with the compatibility and replay semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The highest-risk part is the central outbound/gateway resolver behavior, and recent history shows this person working in that area.
